retracted.note: OpenAlex 中文撤稿记录有限（17 条可用），这是外部真值，不是构造标签。

predatory.note: 产品没有 predatory 期刊检测器；venue 不一致会被当作元数据偏差，不能算作 predatory 识别率。

definitions.problem: label != Exact; product flags when status is Minor/Major
definitions.unknown: counted as a miss (could not verify, not clean)
definitions.predatory: no detector; venue mismatch is not counted as detection
